dashboard.label: Better Map - IoT Sensor Field
dashboard.description: 2,500 simulated IoT sensors over central Europe rendered as a 3D-extruded H3 hexbin heatmap. Top-row KPIs (sensors online, mean reading, max reading, sensors over threshold, hottest zone), zone + sensor-type filter dropdowns, top-zones table, alarming-sensors table, mean-reading-over-time area chart. Carto Dark Matter basemap, viridis ramp, cinematic 3D pitch.
